questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: I found it crucial to go on exchange to a place where I could make international connections. Therefore I chose Barcelona, which indeed is an international city. Furthermore, I found it crucial to go to a university of which I could study my academic interests.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: In courses of which the professors were engaged and interactive I had very good experience. Though, in other courses I found a lack of engagement from the professors.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Difficult. The bureaucratic system was complicated.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: I got assistance from the internacional student office. They were very kind to help.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer:
I used the webpage called "
idealista.com
" where I found a room. It took a lot of effort but after 1 week of looking everyday I found a place.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: From my experiences, and from what I heard, there are no contract and a lot of fake profiles. Therefore make sure to visit the place and talk to the landlord (owner of the building) before to move in.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: I did not use it.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: I had to do a lot of steps. These are what I remembered, First I had to write different emails to different persons. Then I had to meet physically at campus at the internacional student office. Then I had to fill out some physical documents of which I needed to select the courses I wanted. Then I had to go to another office to get a stamp. After that I returned to the first office to deliver back the documents. From there I had to wait a few days and then return to the internacional office ones again to do a final check in.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Email correspondance

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I got all the classes I wanted to. Also classes outside of anthropology in philosophy and history.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Do not get stressed out by the long process of registration. It will work in the end.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: I participated in 5 courses of which the academic programme differed a lot from each other. Also, of what I am used to, there were many exams and hand-ins during the semestre, including mid-term exams, which created a heavy workload.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Generally a high level of academia in the courses.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: In general the style of teaching differed from that of UCPH. At my host institution we did not have as many discussions as in UCPH and the teachers were not interacting that much with the students. Though, I had two courses in anthropology in my host institution with a high level of interaction.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Go to the mountains for example Montseny or to small beaches at Costa Brava.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: In general people are very friendly and accommodating

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Go to small bars or jazzclubs. Also living with local people/students.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: I did not find any cultural difference particularly challenging

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Openness and being outside the most of the time

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Be open for challenges, socialize and enjoy.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Do not panic if you do not understand a lot in the beginning in your classes. It is difficult to study in another language but it gets better during the stay.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Get new friends and contacts

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Studying in spanish
